# Definition of done: Relay delivery plan

## A task is done when

- [ ] Every acceptance item in its task file is met, and every step is finished (its step issue closed).
- [ ] Every check listed in its task file passes, run fresh, with the output kept as evidence.
- [ ] Tests were written first for behavior changes, and no test was weakened to pass.
- [ ] Only the files the task may change were changed; anything else is a new task.
- [ ] An independent review against the acceptance items found no open correctness gaps.
- [ ] The pull request is merged with every CI check green (`gh pr checks`), and the issue is closed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`, the process log (decisions and lessons) and `HANDOFF.md` are updated, and the generated docs are regenerated.

## A phase is done when

- [ ] Every task in the phase is done and its exit criteria in [delivery-plan.md](../delivery/delivery-plan.md) are met.
- [ ] Risks and decisions were reviewed and updated, and the next phase is planned in detail in `shared/tasks/relay.json`.
